smallest_test_only_capture_change_propos.proposal: Add an opt-in test recorder at the managed LSP process boundary that, before initialize dispatch, copies the exact resolved gopls executable bytes into a content-addressed fixture and records digest/length/version, exact argv/cwd/environment allowlist, Go executable/toolchain/go env/module-workspace custody; then records length-delimited exact initialize, prepareCallHierarchy, and incomingCalls request/response frames with monotonic ordinals and cumulative byte/message accounting. The recorder must fail closed before semantic dispatch if any required pre-execution field or sink reservation is unavailable, and must never be enabled in production paths.
smallest_test_only_capture_change_propos.non_governance: This proposal is not a plan, implementation, test edit, vector edit, review, GO, or authority increase.
